messages.subject: Importing .loc file error
parts:
Hi Karl et al.,

I'm attempting to import a .loc file from JoinMap for a four-way cross, retaining the various important header information but removing the extraneous data (as needed).

There appears to be the following error but I'm unsure of how to "fix it". I don't believe it is a whitespace issue though I could be wrong. Any help is appreciated.

Error in read.cross.mq.loc(locfile) :
  nloc=1646 but genotypes are found at 1647 markers


Thanks in advance!
Josh

messages.author: 151953465baea91d
messages.subject: Re: Importing .loc file error
parts: To anyone who encounters this issue in the future, this appears to be related to issues with the primary header line being placed within quotation marks. If these are removed, it appears to solve the issue.
